rows.notes: The document is explicitly a review (abstract: 'This review discusses known SWT criteria for irrigation scheduling'; colloquium paper). It compiles SWT irrigation criteria for onion, potato, cole crops, lettuce, tomato and other crops from the literature (Tables 1-4) and describes sensor types, but reports no new experiment, survey or model runs of its own. Although the first author's own earlier trials are cited, those results belong to the cited primary papers, not to this review. Hence Q1 is 'no' and Q2-Q9 are 'no'.
